commits:
feat(api): add cursor-based pagination to list endpoints

Clients can now pass `?cursor=...` instead of `?page=N` to iterate large
collections without skipping items when records shift between requests.

feat(cli): support `--json` flag on `caboc inspect`

Makes the inspect command machine-readable for CI pipelines.

fix(parser): handle empty token stream without throwing

Previously `parse([])` threw `TypeError: Cannot read 'kind' of undefined`. It now returns an empty AST.
fix(http): retry idempotent requests on 503 instead of failing fast
perf(loader): cache resolved module specifiers across calls
docs(readme): document the new pagination cursor format
test(parser): add fuzz cases for malformed inputs
build(ci): cache pnpm store between jobs
